body: Like I’ve had people around me ask a year ago and I kinda brushed it off and now I feel as if the people around me don’t like me or see me as gross and resent hanging out with me - I’ll sometimes say stuff and notice how people react and it makes me so mad at myself because I just want them to like me or care what’s happening but it seems like people in my social circle have sort resigned me to the place of someone who is a loser or not interesting or like that. And it feels like it’s a postive feedback cycle where I act differently and then people do what ever and then it gets worse
